Name: Sugar
Healing: Doubles the healing value of a food or neutralises its damage

Name: Black Pepper
Healing: Doubles the special value of a food

Name: Salt
Healing: Preserves food, preventing it from spoiling between levels

Name: Ice Crystal
Healing: Freezes food, preserving it for a level but preventing it from being eaten until then

Name: Fire Crystal
Healing: Cooks food, enhancing its attributes. However, cooking food twice will burn it, rendering it inedible
